title: Seeded-invalid finding: no citations, no verification record
content: This fixture violates schemas/findings.schema.json in exactly two named issue classes: its citations array is empty (the schema requires minItems 1 so every finding is source-traceable) and its extensions.harness block carries no verification record (the schema requires the falsification-gate verdict trait). The MIF base object is otherwise well-formed, so the failure isolates the harness-layer gate.
summary: Deliberately fails the ajv finding gate: empty citations and missing extensions.harness.verification.
